parameter.name: MeanEstimatedAtt
parameter.description: Mean estimated attenuation (i.e. channel loss between the local interface and the remote device). It is measured in {{units}}.

parameter.name: SmartRouteIntermediatePLCMAC
parameter.description: Intermediate UPA adapter MAC address of the device that is acting as a relay to increase coverage in mesh scenarios. This is the MAC address of a third UPA device, with which the UPA interface is doing smart repeating in order to transmit data to the associated {{param|MACAddress}} UPA device. {{param}} will be empty when {{param|DirectRoute}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: DirectRoute
parameter.description: Route status, where {{true}} indicates ''direct'' and {{false}} indicates ''indirect''.

parameter.name: Active
parameter.description:
Whether or not this node is currently present in the UPA network.
The ability to list inactive nodes is OPTIONAL. If the CPE includes inactive nodes in this table, {{param}} MUST be set to {{false}} for each inactive node. The length of time an inactive node remains listed in this table is a local matter to the CPE.

object.name: Device.UPA.Interface.{i}.ActiveNotch.{i}.
object.description:
This object contains the list of active notches of the UPA interface.
A UPA device can have notches in its spectrum, where no power is transmitted in a given part of the spectrum. These notches are typically located in amateur radio bands, to avoid interference.
Note: All {{object}} entries can be enabled/disabled as a group using the {{param|#.ActiveNotchEnable}} parameter.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Enables or disables the active notch entry.

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: StartFreq
parameter.description: The initial frequency (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

parameter.name: StopFreq
parameter.description: The final frequency (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

parameter.name: Depth
parameter.description: The depth (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

object.name: Device.UPA.Interface.{i}.BridgeFor.{i}.
object.description:
This object represents the bridge table of the UPA interface. Each instance is a bridge table entry.
It shows the MAC addresses of the remote UPA devices with their associated port number, and the MAC addresses of the end-devices (PCs, STBs, routers, etc) connected to Ethernet port of the powerline adapters with their associated logical port. In this way the system identifies to which UPA device an external device is connected to.

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: MACAddress
parameter.description: MAC address of the device.

parameter.name: Port
parameter.description: Internal bridge associated port.

object.name: Device.UPA.Diagnostics.
object.description: The UPA Diagnostics object.

command.name: InterfaceMeasurement()
command.description:
This command provides access to either a Signal-to-Noise-Ratio (SNR) Port Measurement test or a Channel Frequency Response (CFR) Port Measurement test. The {{param|Type}} parameter is used to select which type of test to perform.
CFR and SNR measurements are done between a two UPA devices (a local interface and a remote device belonging to the same network).

parameter.name: Type
parameter.description: Indicates the type of port measurement test to be carried out. {{enum}}.

enumeration.description: Signal-to-Noise-Ratio
Channel Frequency Response

parameter.name: Interface
parameter.description: {{reference}} This is the local UPA interface from which the test is to be performed.

parameter.name: Port
parameter.description: PLC port being measured. This identifies which PLC connection to measure between the local interface (indicated by {{param|Interface}}) and the remote device (implied by {{param}}).

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description:
Indicates the availability of diagnostics data. {{enum}}
If the value of this parameter is anything other than {{enum|Complete}}, the values of the other results parameters for this test are indeterminate.

parameter.name: Measurements
parameter.description:
{{list}} Result of Signal-to-Noise-Ratio measurement (if {{param|Type}} is {{enum|SNR|Type}}) or Channel Frequency Response measurement (if {{param|Type}} is {{enum|CFR|Type}}).
List items indicate measurements per carrier for a PLC port (expressed in {{units}}).

parameter.name: RxGain
parameter.description: Reception gain of the adapter (expresssed in {{units}}).

object.name: Device.WiFi.
object.description: The WiFi object is based on the IEEE 802.11 specifications ({{bibref|802.11-2020}}). It defines interface objects ({{object|Radio}} and {{object|SSID}}), and application objects ({{object|AccessPoint}} and {{object|EndPoint}}).

parameter.name: RadioNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: SSIDNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: AccessPointNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: EndPointNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: ResetCounter
parameter.description: This parameter counts the number of WiFi host or driver resets since the last device reset. This parameter is reset to zero after the device resets, and increments with each successive WiFi host or driver reset.

parameter.name: ResetCause
parameter.description: Reports the cause for the previous Wi-Fi driver reset.

enumeration.description: Indicates that the host processor intentionally performed the reset. This can be due to an external instruction.
Indicates that the reset was spontaneous. This can be due to an error condition.
Indicates that the reset was due to a loss of mains power on the device.

command.name: NeighboringWiFiDiagnostic()
command.description: This command defines access to other WiFi SSIDs that this device is able to receive.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description:
Indicates the availability of diagnostics data. {{enum}}
If the value of this parameter is anything other than {{enum|Complete}}, the values of the other results parameters for this test are indeterminate.

object.name: Result.{i}.
object.description: Neighboring SSID table. This table models other WiFi SSIDs that this device is able to receive.

parameter.name: Radio
parameter.description: The Radio that detected the neighboring WiFi SSID.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The current service set identifier in use by the neighboring WiFi SSID. The value MAY be empty for hidden SSIDs.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: The BSSID used for the neighboring WiFi SSID.

parameter.name: Mode
parameter.description: The mode the neighboring WiFi radio is operating in.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The current radio channel used by the neighboring WiFi radio.

parameter.name: SignalStrength
parameter.description: An indicator of radio signal strength (RSSI) of the neighboring WiFi radio measured in {{units}}, as an average of the last 100 packets received.

parameter.name: SecurityModeEnabled
parameter.description:
The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises.
The {{enum|WEP}} value indicates either WEP-64 or WEP-128.
The {{enum|WPA}} value is the same as WPA-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA2}} value is the same as WPA2-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA-WPA2}} value is the same as WPA-WPA2-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA3-SAE}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal-Transition.
The {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE-RSNO}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal-Compatibility.

parameter.name: EncryptionMode
parameter.description:
The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises.
When {{param|SecurityModeEnabled}} is one of {{enum|WPA3-SAE|SecurityModeEnabled}}, {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE|SecurityModeEnabled}}, or {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE-RSNO|SecurityModeEnabled}}, or {{enum|WPA3-Enterprise|SecurityModeEnabled}}, {{enum|TKIP}} is not valid, and should not be in the list.

parameter.name: OperatingFrequencyBand
parameter.description: Indicates the frequency band at which the radio this SSID instance is operating.

parameter.name: SupportedStandards
parameter.description:
{{list}} List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standards this {{object}} instance can support simultaneously, in the frequency band specified by {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}}. {{enum}}
Each value indicates support for the indicated standard.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|2.4GHz|OperatingFrequencyBand}}, only values {{enum|b}}, {{enum|g}}, {{enum|n}}, {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|5GHz|OperatingFrequencyBand}}, only values {{enum|a}}, {{enum|n}}, {{enum|ac}}, {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|6GHz|OperatingFrequencyBand}}, only values {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.

enumeration.description: {{bibref|802.11ax}}
{{bibref|802.11be}}

parameter.name: OperatingStandards
parameter.description:
{{list}} List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standard that is detected for this {{object}}.
Each value indicates support for the indicated standard.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|2.4GHz|##.Radio.{i}.SupportedFrequencyBands}}, only values {{enum|b}}, {{enum|g}}, {{enum|n}}, {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|5GHz|##.Radio.{i}.SupportedFrequencyBands}}, only values {{enum|a}}, {{enum|n}}, {{enum|ac}}, {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.
If {{param|OperatingFrequencyBand}} is set to {{enum|6GHz|##.Radio.{i}.SupportedFrequencyBands}}, only value {{enum|ax}}, {{enum|be}} are allowed.
For example, a value of "g,b" (or "b,g" - order is not important) means that the 802.11g standard {{bibref|802.11g-2003}} is used with a backwards-compatible mode for 802.11b {{bibref|802.11b-1999}}. A value of "g" means that only the 802.11g standard can be used.

parameter.name: OperatingChannelBandwidth
parameter.description: Indicates the bandwidth at which the channel is operating.

parameter.name: BeaconPeriod
parameter.description: Time interval (in {{units}}) between transmitting beacons.

parameter.name: Noise
parameter.description: Indicator of average noise strength (in {{units}}) received from the neighboring WiFi radio.

parameter.name: BasicDataTransferRates
parameter.description: {{list}} Basic data transmit rates (in Mbps) for the SSID. For example, if {{param}} is "1,2", this indicates that the SSID is operating with basic rates of 1 Mbps and 2 Mbps.

parameter.name: SupportedDataTransferRates
parameter.description: {{list}} Data transmit rates (in Mbps) for unicast frames at which the SSID will permit a station to connect. For example, if {{param}} is "1,2,5.5", this indicates that the SSID will only permit connections at 1 Mbps, 2 Mbps and 5.5 Mbps.

parameter.name: DTIMPeriod
parameter.description: The number of beacon intervals (measured in {{units}}) that elapse between transmission of Beacon frames containing a TIM element whose DTIM count field is 0. This value is transmitted in the DTIM Period field of beacon frames. {{bibref|802.11-2020}}

parameter.description: {{param}} is a reference to the IEEE 1905.1 Network Topology Device. Since IEEE 1905.1 is a common protocol used by Multi-AP Controllers for communications, this parameter allows the MultiAP portion of the data model to reference the associated IEEE 1905.1 portion of the data model.

parameter.name: BackhaulLinkType
BackhaulMACAddress
parameter.description:
The MAC Address of the Device on the network that is providing a Backhaul Link for this Access Point Device.
{{empty}} is reserved for the {{object}} instance that represents the Multi-AP Controller.

parameter.name: BackhaulBytesSent
parameter.description: The total number of bytes transmitted across the backhaul medium (as identified by the value of the {{param|BackhaulLinkType}} parameter), including framing characters.

parameter.name: BackhaulBytesReceived

A value of 0 is used for the {{object}} instance that represents the Access Point on the Multi-AP Controller.

parameter.name: BackhaulSignalStrength

command.name: SetTrafficSeparation()
command.description:
This command allows or disallows EasyMesh traffic separation {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 19.1}}. If {{param|Enable}} is {{true}} then the parameters defining traffic separation details can also be input with this command.
This command applies to all EasyMesh Agent devices in the Wi-Fi network.
This command can configure {{object|#.Device.{i}.SSIDtoVIDMapping.{i}.}} and {{param|#.Device.{i}.TrafficSeparationAllowed}}.
Status is to be returned after implementation or failed implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
: {{true}}: EasyMesh traffic separation is allowed.
: {{false}}: EasyMesh traffic separation is not allowed.

object.name: SSIDtoVIDMapping.{i}.
object.description:
The Service Set Identifier (SSID) to VLAN ID (VID) mapping for EasyMesh traffic separation {{bibref|EasyMesh}}. Consists of a table of pairs of {{param|SSID}} and corresponding {{param|VID}}.
If this input is not provided, then existing {{object|##.Device.{i}.SSIDtoVIDMapping.{i}.}} apply.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The SSID name.

parameter.name: VID
parameter.description: The VLAN ID (VID).

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to allow or disallow EasyMesh traffic separation. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Indicates successful implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network.

command.name: SetServicePrioritization()
command.description:
This command allows or disallows EasyMesh service prioritization {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 20}}. If {{param|Enable}} is {{true}} then the parameters defining service prioritization details can also be input with this command.
This command can configure {{object|#.Device.{i}.SPRule.{i}.}}, {{param|#.Device.{i}.DSCPMap}} and {{param|#.Device.{i}.ServicePrioritizationAllowed}}.
This command applies to all EasyMesh Agent devices in the Wi-Fi network.
Status is to be returned after implementation or failed implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
: {{true}}: EasyMesh service prioritization is allowed.
: {{false}}: EasyMesh service prioritization is not allowed.

parameter.name: DSCPMap
parameter.description:
A hexadecimal string of 64 PCP values (one octet per value) corresponding to the DSCP markings 0x00 to 0x3F, ordered by increasing DSCP value. Each octet is in the range 0x00 - 0x07. This is used to select a PCP value if a Service Prioritization Rule specifies Rule Output: 0x08.
If this input is not provided, then the existing {{param|#.Device.{i}.DSCPMap}} applies.

object.name: SPRule.{i}.
object.description:
This object describes a list of service prioritization (SP) rules {{bibref|EasyMesh}}.
If this input is not provided, then existing {{object|##.Device.{i}.SPRule.{i}.}} apply.

parameter.name: ID
parameter.description: Service prioritization rule Identifier.

parameter.name: Precedence
parameter.description: Rule Precedence - higher number means higher priority.

parameter.name: Output
parameter.description: Rule Output. The value of, or method used to select the 802.1Q C-TAG Priority Code Point (PCP) output value.

parameter.name: AlwaysMatch
parameter.description: Indicates if the rule always matches.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to allow or disallow EasyMesh service prioritization. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Indicates successful implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network

command.name: SetPreferredBackhauls()
command.description: This command sets preferred backhaul links for EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} backhaul.

object.name: PreferredBackhauls.{i}.
object.description:
Indicates preferred backhaul links for EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} backhaul. Consists of a table of pairs of MAC addresses. For a WI-Fi connection pair, an entry contains the BSSID and bSTA MAC address. For a wired connection pair, an entry contains the interface MAC addresses. This command applies to all EasyMesh Agent devices in the Wi-Fi network.
Status is to be returned after implementation or failed implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network.

parameter.name: BackhaulMACAddress
parameter.description: The MAC address of the BSS, or similar Ethernet interface, on this preferred backhaul link.

parameter.name: bSTAMACAddress
parameter.description: The MAC address of the backhaul STA (bSTA), or similar Ethernet interface, on this preferred backhaul link.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to set preferred backhaul links. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Indicates successful implementation of all preferred backhaul links in this Multi-AP network.

command.name: SetSSID()
command.description:
This command specifies an {{param|SSID}} for use across this Wi-Fi Multi-AP network, or on this single-AP. Also specifies the {{param|PassPhrase}}, whether to add or remove this SSID, and specifies the {{param|Band}} for each {{param|SSID}}.
This command applies to all EasyMesh Agent devices in the Wi-Fi network, or to this AP in the single-AP case.
This command can be used to change any input parameter(s) if {{param|AddRemoveChange}} is set to {{enum|Change|AddRemoveChange}}.
This command can configure {{object|#.SSID.{i}}}.
Note that VLAN IDs (VIDs) can be configured per SSID with {{object|#.Device.{i}.SSIDtoVIDMapping.{i}}}.
Status is to be returned after implementation or failed implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The SSID for fronthaul use across this Wi-Fi Multi-AP network.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
Enable or disable this {{param|SSID}}. Disable stops the use of this {{param|SSID}}, but the object is retained.
: {{true}}: this {{param|SSID}} is to be enabled.
: {{false}}: this {{param|SSID}} is to be disabled.

parameter.name: AddRemoveChange

enumeration.description: Add this SSID.
Remove this SSID.
Change this SSID.

parameter.name: PassPhrase
parameter.description: The WPA2 Passphrase and/or SAE password for this {{param|SSID}}.

parameter.name: Band

enumeration.description: Applies to all bands
2.4 GHz band
The entire 5 GHz band
The entire 6 GHz band
5 GHz UNII-1 band, 5.15 to 5.25 GHz
5 GHz UNII-2 band, 5.25 to 5.725 GHz
5 GHz UNII-3 band, 5.725 to 5.85 GHz
5 GHz UNII-4 band, 5.85 to 5.925 GHz
6 GHz UNII-5 band, 5.925 to 6.425 GHz
6 GHz UNII-6 band, 6.425 to 6.525 GHz
6 GHz UNII-7 band, 6.525 to 6.875 GHz
6 GHz UNII-8 band, 6.875 to 7.125 GHz

parameter.name: AKMsAllowed
parameter.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed on this BSS. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: "psk" indicates one or more of the PSK and FT-PSK AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:2" for interoperability.
"dpp" indicates one or more of the DPP and FT-DPP AKMs defined in {{bibref|EasyConnect|Section 8.4}}, typically at least "50-6F-9A:2" for interoperability.
"sae" indicates one or more of the SAE and FT-SAE AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:8" for interoperability.
"SuiteSelector" indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in {{param|SuiteSelector}}.

parameter.name: SuiteSelector
parameter.description:
AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.
This parameter applies if {{param|AKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameter.name: AdvertisementEnabled
parameter.description:
Indicates if the SSID is advertised in beacons, or not.
: {{true}}: this {{param|SSID}} is to be advertised in beacons.
: {{false}}: this {{param|SSID}} is not to be advertised in beacons.

parameter.name: MFPConfig
parameter.description: Management Frame Protection (MFP) configuration. {{enum}}

parameter.name: MobilityDomain
parameter.description: The IEEE 802.11 mobility domain {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.46}}.

parameter.name: HaulType
parameter.description: Indicates the use of this {{param|SSID}}. {{enum}}

parameter.name: Type
parameter.description:
Human-readable name for this {{object}}. For example {{param}} could be one of Primary, Home, Guest, Public, Private, Children, Video, or Backhaul.
This parameter is ignored if it is not provided.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to set the SSID. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Indicates successful implementation on all agents/devices/APs in this Multi-AP network

event.name: ControllerBTMSteer!
event.description: This event provides a steering BTM report, due to a controller-initiated BTM client steer {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.30, Steering BTM Report TLV}}.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: Unique identifier of the source BSS or AP_MLD_MAC_Addr for which the steering BTM report applies.

parameter.name: STAMAC
parameter.description: STA MAC address or STA MLD MAC address for which the steering BTM report applies.

parameter.name: BTMStatusCode
parameter.description: Indicates the value of the BTM Status Code as reported by the STA in the BTM Response {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-42}}. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Accept (note that the STA may not have actually reassociated with this code)
Reject—Unspecified reject reason
Reject—Insufficient Beacon or Probe Response frames received from all candidates
Reject—Insufficient available capacity from all candidates.
Reject—BSS termination undesired.
Reject—BSS termination delay requested.
Reject—STA BSS Transition Candidate List provided.
Reject—No suitable BSS transition candidates.
Reject—Leaving ESS.

parameter.description: The IEEE 1905 {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a}} Abstraction-Layer ID (ALID) of the EasyMesh Agent on the network that is providing the backhaul for this EasyMesh Agent.

parameter.name: SoftwareVersion
parameter.description:
Identifier of the software version currently installed in the Access Point device (i.e. version of the overall firmware).

parameter.name: DSCPMap
parameter.description: A hexadecimal string of 64 Priority Code Point (PCP) values (one octet per value) corresponding to the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) markings 0x00 to 0x3F, ordered by increasing DSCP value. Each octet is in the range 0x00 - 0x07. This is used to select a PCP value if a Service Prioritization Rule specifies Rule Output: 0x08

parameter.name: TestCapabilities
parameter.description:
Indicates EasyMesh agent support for running a throughput or latency test.
0 indicates that the EasyMesh Agent or single-AP does not support any throughput test and does not support a latency test.
1 indicates that the EasyMesh Agent or single-AP supports a throughput test but does not support a latency test.
2 indicates that the EasyMesh Agent or single-AP supports a latency test but does not support a throughput test.
3 indicates that the EasyMesh Agent or single-AP supports a throughput test and a latency test.

parameter.name: BurstStartTime
parameter.description:
Least significant 4 octets of the TSF timer of the Reference BSSID, at the start of the anticipated first burst of channel usage.
Note: a burst is a continuous or quasi-continuous period of channel usage. For IEEE 802.11 transmissions, a burst might comprise only one PPDU, or multiple closely spaced PPDUs.

parameter.name: Repetitions

parameter.description: Bitmask of 26-tone Resource Units (RUs) defined in {{bibref|802.11ax|Section 27.3.2.2}}, where the (i-1)th bit position is set to one if the nominal bandwidth of the channel usage corresponding to this entry fully or partially overlaps with the RUi, and is otherwise set to zero.

parameter.name: TransmitterIdentifier
PowerLevel
parameter.description: Indicates maximum transmit power during each channel usage burst in {{units}}; equal to 255 when unknown or when the entry corresponds to multiple transmitters with different transmit powers

enumeration.description: TSPEC or other traffic stream with predictable characteristics.

IEEE 802.11 transmitter external to the BSSs operated by the reporting Agent.
Non-IEEE 802.11, or unknown source.
BSS non-usage (in this special case, a burst is defined as a continuous period in which the Agent ensures no transmissions by any of its BSSs on the channel).

command.name: SteerWiFiBackhaul()
command.description:
This command requests the Wi-Fi backhaul link to be steered to associate to a different BSS when the device is working as a bridge in a mesh network. The device needs to already have the necessary credentials for the switch to happen.
The {{param|TargetBSS}} should be an instance of a Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.BSSID.

parameter.name: TargetBSS
parameter.description: Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID) of the target BSS which the associated device(s) is to be associated to.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The number of the Wi-Fi channel the backhaul BSS is to be associated to. If {{param}} is not specified, then the radio is to determine which channel to use to associate to the requested {{param|TargetBSS}}.

parameter.name: TimeOut
parameter.description: The maximum timeout for this backhaul steering to occur in {{units}}.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the response to the Wi-Fi backhaul steering request. {{enum}}

Describes one of the current Operating Classes in use by this Radio. One Opeating Class is indicated for each current Operating Channel Bandwidth.
The Channel indicated for the 20 MHz Operating Class is equal to the current primary channel.

parameter.name: Class
parameter.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} that this radio is currently operating on.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: This Channel number in the Operating Class that this Radio is currently operating on.

parameter.name: TxPower
parameter.description:
Nominal Transmit Power EIRP that this radio is currently using for the current Channel in the Opeating Class.
Represented as 2's complement signed integer in units of decibels relative to 1 mW ({{units}}).

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this group was collected.

A value of 0 is used for the {{object}} instance that represents the Access Point on the Multi-AP Controller.

RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}. object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.
object.description: This object represents all of the individual Radios contained within the identified Access Point device known to the controller.

parameter.name: ID
parameter.description: A unique identifier for this particular Radio within the identified Access Point as defined in {{bibref|DataElements|Section 3.1}}.

parameter.name: Enabled
parameter.description:
Indicates whether this radio is enabled or disabled.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.Enable}}.

parameter.name: RadioTemplateRef
parameter.description: {{param}} is a reference to the RadioTemplate selected for this {{object}}.

parameter.name: Noise
parameter.description:
An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power measured for the primary operating channel.
Encoded as defined for ANPI in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.10.9.4}}.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.Stats.Noise}}.

parameter.name: Utilization
parameter.description:
(Total Channel Utililzation) The percentage of time (linearly scaled with 255 representing 100%) that the Access Point device sensed the medium was busy, as indicated by either the physical or virtual carier sense (CS) mechanism. This is essentially the amount of time spent transmitting (both successful and failed transmissions), receiving (both local and non-local transmissions), and processing noise {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.
When more than one channel is in use for the BSS operating on the radio, the {{param}} value is calculated only for the primary channel.

parameter.name: Transmit
parameter.description:
(Transmit Channel Utilization) The percentage of time (linearly scaled with 255 representing 100%) that the radio has spent on sending individually or group addressed transmissions (successful and failed).
When more than one channel is in use for the BSS operating on the radio, the {{param}} value is calculated only for the primary channel.

parameter.name: ReceiveSelf
parameter.description:
(Receive Local Channel Utilization) The percentage of time (linearly scaled with 255 representing 100%) that the radio has spent on receiving individually or group addressed local transmissions (i.e. transmissions from any STA associated with any BSS operating on this radio).
When more than one channel is in use for the BSS operating on the radio, the {{param}} value is calculated only for the primary channel.

parameter.name: ReceiveOther
parameter.description:
(Receive Non-Local Channel Utilization) The percentage of time (linearly scaled with 255 representing 100%) that the radio has spent on receiving individually or group addressed non-local transmissions (i.e. valid IEEE 802.11 PPDUs that are not associated with any BSS operating on this radio).
When more than one channel is in use for the BSS operating on the radio, the {{param}} value is calculated only for the primary channel.

parameter.name: TrafficSeparationCombinedFronthaul
parameter.description: Indicates traffic separation on combined fronthaul and Profile-1 backhaul support {{bibref|EasyMesh}}.

parameter.name: TrafficSeparationCombinedBackhaul
parameter.description: Indicates traffic separation on combined Profile-1 backhaul and Profile-2 backhaul support {{bibref|EasyMesh}}.

parameter.name: SteeringPolicy
ChannelUtilizationThreshold
parameter.description: Channel Utilization Threshold (defined per Basic Service Set (BSS) Load element {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.).

parameter.name: RCPISteeringThreshold

command.name: ChannelScanRequest()
command.description:
Request to initiate a channel scan. The operating classes, and list of channels for each operating class, are input. If no operating class is provided to the input, then all available opclasses and channels are to be scanned. For 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, only 20MHz operating classes are valid inputs.
This command should result in updating {{object|Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.ScanResult.}}

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description:
The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. For 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, only 20MHz Operating Classes are valid. If this input is not provided, then all available opclasses and channels are to be scanned.
Note that the operating class identifies the band, and channel width.

parameter.name: ChannelList
parameter.description: The channel numbers in this Operating Class for which the request to initiate a channel scan applies.

parameter.name: ScanType
parameter.description: Indicates the type of scan to perform. If this is omitted, or is not supported by the device, then it should be ignored. {{enum}}

parameter.name: DwellTime
parameter.description:
The duration of the time to scan each channel in {{units}}. A value of 50 {{units}} is suggested.
If this is omitted, or is not supported by the device, then it should be ignored.

parameter.name: DFSDwellTime
parameter.description:
The duration of time to scan each Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) channel in {{units}}. Note that this is the time to scan the channel, and is not the time to perform DFS. A value of at least one beacon interval, typically 100 {{units}}, is suggested.
If this is omitted, or is not supported by the device, then it should be ignored.

parameter.name: HomeTime
parameter.description:
The time in {{units}} after which the driver has to go back to the original channel before scanning the next channel to avoid disruption.
If this is omitted, or is not supported by the device, then it should be ignored.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to initiate a channel scan. {{enum}}

command.name: RadioEnable()
command.description:
Request to enable or disable this radio.
This command can result in updating {{param|Enabled}}.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.}}, then this command has the same effect as writing to {{param|Device.WiFi.Radio.{i}.Enable}}.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
: {{true}}: this radio is to be enabled.
: {{false}}: this radio is to be disabled.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to enable or disable this radio. {{enum}}

command.name: SetTxPowerLimit()
command.description:
This command sets the upper limit on transmit power {{param|TransmitPowerLimit}} for this radio and {{param|OperatingClass}}.
This command can configure {{param|#.CurrentOperatingClassProfile.{i}.TransmitPowerLimit}}.

parameter.name: TransmitPowerLimit
parameter.description: This is the upper limit on nominal transmit Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) that this radio can use for the {{param|OperatingClass}}. In units of decibels relative to 1 mW {{units}}.

parameter.name: OperatingClass
parameter.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} of the radio. Note that the Operating Class identifies the band and channel width.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to set a transmit power limit. {{enum}}

command.name: SetSpatialReuse()
command.description:
This command sets the spatial reuse configuration of this radio. Applies only to Wi-Fi 6 and possibly later generations of radios.
Acronyms: Spatial Reuse Group (SRG), Overlapping Basic Service Set (OBSS), Preamble Detection (PD).
This command can configure {{object|#.SpatialReuse.}}.
If some input parameter(s) are not provided, then the corresponding existing parameter in {{object|#.SpatialReuse.}} applies.

parameter.name: BSSColor
parameter.description: The value of the BSS Color subfield of the HEOperations.BSSColorInformation field being transmitted by BSSs operating on this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: BSS Color)

parameter.name: HESIGASpatialReuseValue15Allowed
SRGInformationValid
NonSRGOffsetValid
PSRDisallowed
NonSRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11NonSRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e the Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|NonSRGOffsetValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGOBSSPDMinOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMinOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Min Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Min Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Max Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGBSSColorBitmap
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPBSSColorBitmap (i.e. the SRG BSS Color Bitmap being used to control the tranmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG BSS Color Bitmap)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGPartialBSSIDBitmap
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPBSSIDBitmap (i.e. the SRG Partial BSSID Color Bitmap being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG Partial BSSID Bitmap)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.
Note: See rules in section 26.10.2.3 of [17] regarding the members of an SRG.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to set the spatial reuse configuration of this radio. {{enum}}

command.name: WiFiRestart()
command.description: Request a restart of the Wi-Fi subsystem.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to restart the Wi-Fi subsystem. {{enum}}

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.Capabilities.HaLowCapabilities.

parameter.name: BW4MHz

parameter.name: BW8MHz

parameter.name: BW16MHz

parameter.name: BW2MHzShortGI

parameter.name: BW4MHzShortGI

parameter.name: BW8MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 8 MHz short GI.

parameter.name: BW16MHzShortGI

parameter.name: AMSDU

parameter.name: AMPDU

parameter.name: FlowControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Flow Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.61}}.

parameter.name: CentralizedAuthenticationControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Centralized Authentication Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.2}}.

parameter.name: DistributedAuthenticationControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Distributed Authentication Control (DAC) {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.3}}.

parameter.name: MaxMPDULen

parameter.name: NonTIMMode

parameter.name: DynamicAID

parameter.name: GroupAID

parameter.name: BATSupport

parameter.name: RAWOperation

parameter.name: PageSlicing

parameter.name: PV1Frame

parameter.name: TxMCSNSS

parameter.name: TravelingPilot

parameter.name: AcceptNonSensorDevices

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.CurrentOperatingClassProfile.{i}.
object.description:
Describes one of the current Operating Classes in use by this Radio. One Operating Class is indicated for each current Operating Channel Bandwidth.
The Channel indicated for the 20 MHz Operating Class is equal to the current primary channel.

parameter.name: Class
parameter.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} that this radio is currently operating on.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: This Channel number in the Operating Class that this Radio is currently operating on.

parameter.name: TxPower
parameter.description:
Nominal Transmit Power EIRP that this radio is currently using for the current Channel in the Opeating Class.
Represented as 2's complement signed integer in units of decibels relative to 1 mW ({{units}}).

parameter.name: TransmitPowerLimit
parameter.description: This is the upper limit on nominal transmit Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) that this radio is allowed to use for the current {{param|Class}}. In units of decibels relative to 1 mW {{units}}.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.DisAllowedOpClassChannels.{i}.
object.description: The operating classes, and list of channels for each operating class, which are not allowed to be used on this radio.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Enables or disables disallowed operating classes and channels.

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description:
The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}.
Note that the operating class identifies the band and channel width.

parameter.name: ChannelList
parameter.description: {{list}} The channel numbers in this Operating Class that are not allowed to be used on this radio.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.OpClassPreference.{i}.
object.description:
Values represent Channel Preference TLV values in the most recent Channel Preference Report message {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.
Each entry in this table describes one of the operating classes for which Channel Preference has been reported.
A Preference score of 15 must be inferred for all channel/operating classes not present in this table, unless that channel/operating class has been reported as statically non-operable in the most recent AP Radio Basic Capabilities TLV {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.7}}.

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description:
The operating class {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. Note that the operating class identifies the band and channel width.
Values represent the OpClass field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.

parameter.name: ChannelList
parameter.description:
The channel numbers in this operating class.
{{list}} Values represent the Channel List field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.

parameter.name: Preference
parameter.description:
The reported preference for this {{param|OpClass}} and {{param|ChannelList}}, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.
Values represent the Preference field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.

parameter.name: ReasonCode
parameter.description:
Reason Code. Indicates the reason for the {{param|Preference}}, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.
Values represent the Reason_Code field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message {{bibref|EasyMesh|17.2.13}}.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.SpatialReuse.
object.description:
The spatial reuse configuration of this radio. Applies only to Wi-Fi 6 {{bibref|802.11ax}} and possibly later generations of radios.
Acronyms: Spatial Reuse Group (SRG), Overlapping Basic Service Set (OBSS), Preamble Detection (PD).

parameter.name: PartialBSSColor
parameter.description: The value of the Partial Basic Service Set (BSS) Color subfield of the HEOperations.BSSColorInformation field being transmitted by BSSs operating on this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: Partial BSS Color)

parameter.name: BSSColor
parameter.description: The value of the BSS Color subfield of the HEOperations.BSSColorInformation field being transmitted by BSSs operating on this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: BSS Color)

parameter.name: HESIGASpatialReuseValue15Allowed
SRGInformationValid
NonSRGOffsetValid
PSRDisallowed
NonSRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11NonSRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e the Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|NonSRGOffsetValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGOBSSPDMinOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMinOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Min Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Min Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Max Offset)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGBSSColorBitmap
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPBSSColorBitmap (i.e. the SRG BSS Color Bitmap being used to control the tranmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG BSS Color Bitmap)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.

parameter.name: SRGPartialBSSIDBitmap
parameter.description:
The value of dot11SRGAPBSSIDBitmap (i.e. the SRG Partial BSSID Color Bitmap being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG Partial BSSID Bitmap)
This field is valid only if {{param|SRGInformationValid}} is {{true}}.
Note: See rules in section 26.10.2.3 of [17] regarding the members of an SRG.

parameter.name: NeighborBSSColorInUseBitmap
parameter.description: Bitmap of BSS colors of Overlapping BSSs (OBSSs) that the High-Efficiency (HE) AP has identified by itself or via the autonomous BSS Color collision reports received from associated non-AP HE STAs.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.
object.description: A single logical BSS operating on this radio.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description:
The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID).
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.BSSID}}.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description:
The SSID in use for this BSS.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID}}.

parameter.name: Enabled
parameter.description:
Whether the BSSID is currently enabled (beaconing frames are being sent) or disabled.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.Enable}}.

parameter.name: BSSTemplateRef
parameter.description: {{param}} is a reference to the BSSTemplate selected for this {{object}}.

parameter.name: SecurityTemplateRef
parameter.description: {{param}} is a reference to the SecurityTemplate selected for this {{object}}.

parameter.name: LastChange
parameter.description:
Time in {{units}} since the last change to the {{param|Enabled}} value.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.LastChange}}.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: UnicastBytesSent
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes transmitted.
This counter does not include Multi-Link Device (MLD) traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: UnicastBytesReceived
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes received.
This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: MulticastBytesSent
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes transmitted.
This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: MulticastBytesReceived
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes received.
This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: BroadcastBytesSent
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes transmitted.
This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: BroadcastBytesReceived
parameter.description:
Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes received.
This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameter.name: ByteCounterUnits
parameter.description:
Byte Counter Units.
: 1: kibibytes (KiB)
: 2: mebibytes (MiB).

parameter.name: Profile1bSTAsDisallowed
Profile2bSTAsDisallowed
AssociationAllowanceStatus
parameter.description:
The status of allowance of new client device associations on this BSS.
: 0: No more associations allowed,
: 1: Associations allowed.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersBE
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BE, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersBK
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BK, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersVI
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VI, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersVO
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VO, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: BackhaulUse
parameter.description:
Indicates that this BSS is in use as a backhaul BSS;
: {{true}}: backhaul BSS in use,
: {{false}}: backhaul BSS not in use.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameter.name: FronthaulUse
parameter.description:
Indicates that this BSS is in use as a fronthaul BSS;
: {{true}}: fronthaul BSS in use,
: {{false}}: fronthaul BSS not in use.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameter.name: R1disallowed
parameter.description:
Multi-AP Profile-1 [3] (R1) disallowed status.
: {{true}}: disallowed,
: {{false}}: allowed.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameter.name: R2disallowed
parameter.description:
Multi-AP Profile-2 [3] (R2) disallowed status.
: {{true}}: disallowed,
: {{false}}: allowed.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}} 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameter.name: MultiBSSID
parameter.description:
Multiple BSSID Set;
: {{true}}: configured,
: {{false}}: not-configured.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}}, 1 is configured and 0 is not-configured.

parameter.name: TransmittedBSSID
parameter.description:
Transmitted BSSID;
: {{true}}: transmitted,
: {{false}}: non-transmitted.
In {{bibref|EasyMesh}}, 1 is transmitted and 0 is non-transmitted.

parameter.name: FronthaulAKMsAllowed
parameter.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for fronthaul. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: "psk" indicates one or more of the PSK and FT-PSK AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:2" for interoperability.
"dpp" indicates one or more of the DPP and FT-DPP AKMs defined in {{bibref|EasyConnect|Section 8.4}}, typically at least "50-6F-9A:2" for interoperability.
"sae" indicates one or more of the SAE and FT-SAE AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:8" for interoperability.
"SuiteSelector" indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in {{param|FronthaulSuiteSelector}}.

parameter.name: FronthaulSuiteSelector
parameter.description:
AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.
This parameter applies if {{param|FronthaulAKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameter.name: BackhaulAKMsAllowed
parameter.description: {{list}} List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for backhaul. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: "psk" indicates one or more of the PSK and FT-PSK AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:2" for interoperability.
"dpp" indicates one or more of the DPP and FT-DPP AKMs defined in {{bibref|EasyConnect|Section 8.4}}, typically at least "50-6F-9A:2" for interoperability.
"sae" indicates one or more of the SAE and FT-SAE AKMs defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}} typically at least "00-0F-AC:8" for interoperability.
"SuiteSelector" indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in {{param|BackhaulSuiteSelector}}.

parameter.name: BackhaulSuiteSelector
parameter.description:
AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.
This parameter applies if {{param|BackhaulAKMsAllowed}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameter.name: BasicDataTransmitRates
parameter.description: {{list}} The current basic data rates; the set of data rates, in {{units}}, that have to be supported by all stations that desire to join this BSS. The stations have to be able to receive and transmit at each of the data rates listed in {{param}}. Most control packets use a data rate in {{param}}.

parameter.name: STANumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: QMDescriptorNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

command.name: SetQMDescriptors()
command.description:
This command configures each of the descriptor elements for Mirrored Stream Classification Service (MSCS), Stream Classification Service (SCS), or QoS Management. {{bibref|EasyMesh}}.
This command can configure {{object|QMDescriptor.{i}.}}.
If {{param|Input.QMDescriptor.{i}.DescriptorElement}} is for SCS or MSCS, the AP adds/changes/removes the rule according to the descriptor element request type.
If a {{param|Input.QMDescriptor.{i}.DescriptorElement}} is a QoS Management DSCP Policy, the AP sends it to the STA identified by the {{param|Input.QMDescriptor.{i}.ClientMAC}}.

object.name: QMDescriptor.{i}.
object.description: This object contains a table of {{param|DescriptorElement}}.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: The BSSID of BSS for which this descriptor applies.

parameter.name: ClientMAC
parameter.description: MAC address of the Station (STA) for which this descriptor applies.

parameter.name: DescriptorElement
parameter.description:
The descriptor element. One of:
: MSCS descriptor element (as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.243}}, or
: SCS descriptor element (as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.121}}, or
: QoS Management DSCP policy element (as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.94}} and {{bibref|RFC8325|Section 6.3}}).

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to configure descriptor elements. {{enum}}

command.name: ThroughputTest()
command.description:
This command represents a request to initiate a throughput (speed) test from a BSS to a STA.
This command should populate {{object|ThroughputTestResult}}.

parameter.name: STAMACAddress
parameter.description: MAC address of the STA that the throughput test is to be run to.

parameter.name: VID
parameter.description: The VLAN ID (VID) that the throughput test is to run on.

parameter.name: WMMUP
parameter.description:
Wi-Fi MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority {{bibref|AMB}} that the throughput test is to run on. A value of 8 indicates that the WMM UP is not specified.
If WMM is not supported by the BSS and the STA, then this is ignored.

parameter.name: TestDuration
parameter.description: Duration of the throughput test in {{units}}.

parameter.name: TestDirection
parameter.description: Direction to run the throughput test. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Both uplink and downlink.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the throughput test request. {{enum}}

command.name: LatencyTest()
command.description:
This command represents a request to initiate a latency (delay) test set from a BSS to a STA. Each latency test set includes a number of individual echo tests. Each echo test result provides a sample of round-trip time.
This command should populate {{object|LatencyTestResult}}.

parameter.name: STAMACAddress
parameter.description: MAC address of the STA that the latency test is to be run to.

parameter.name: VID
parameter.description: The VLAN ID (VID) that the latency test is to run on.

parameter.name: WMMUP
parameter.description:
Wi-Fi MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority {{bibref|AMB}} that the latency test is to run on. A value of 8 indicates that the WMM UP is not specified.
If WMM is not supported by the BSS and the STA, then this is ignored.

parameter.name: NumberOfRepetitions
parameter.description:
Number of echo tests to run in the latency test set.
If the value of this field is 0, then this field is ignored.

parameter.name: Timeout
parameter.description:
If any echo test duration exceeds this time in {{units}}, then the echo test is declared a failure.
A value of 0 indicates that no Timeout is specified.

parameter.name: DataBlockSize
parameter.description:
The size of each data block, in {{units}}, transmitted in each echo test.
A value of 0 indicates that no DataBlockSize is specified.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the latency test request. {{enum}}

command.name: SetEHTOperations()
command.description: This command configures Extremely High Throughput (EHT, aka Wi-Fi 7) operations for this BSS {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.103 EHT Operations TLV}}.

parameter.name: EHTDefaultPEDuration
parameter.description: Bit 2 of EHT Operation Parameters field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001b}}.

parameter.name: GroupAddressedBUIndicationLimit
parameter.description: Bit 3 of EHT Operation Parameters field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001b}}.

parameter.name: GroupAddressedBUIndicationExponent
parameter.description: Bits 4-5 of EHT Operation Parameters field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001b}}.

parameter.name: BasicEHTMCSAndNssSet
parameter.description: See EHT Operation element Basic EHT-MCS And Nss Set as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001a}}.

parameter.name: Control
parameter.description: See EHT Operation Information field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001c}}.

parameter.name: CCFS0
parameter.description: See EHT Operation Information field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001c}}.

parameter.name: CCFS1
parameter.description: See EHT Operation Information field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001c}}.

parameter.name: DisabledSubchannelBitmap
parameter.description: Disabled Subchannel Bitmap subfield in EHT Operation Information field as per {{bibref|802.11be|Figure 9-1001c}}. This enables subchannel puncturing.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of this command to configure Extremely High Throughput (EHT, aka Wi-Fi 7). {{enum}}

command.name: SetQoSManagement()
command.description:
This command configures the Wi-Fi QoS Management settings of this BSS. {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 20}}.
This command should populate {{object|SetQoSManagementInput}}.

parameter.name: QosMapEnable

parameter.name: SCSEnable

parameter.name: DSCPPolicyEnable

parameter.name: SCSTrafficDescriptionEnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether the extensions to SCS using Traffic Descriptions is enabled on this BSS.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of this command to configure the Wi-Fi QoS Management settings of this BSS.{{enum}}

BTMQueryResponses

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ThroughputTestResult.
object.description: Object containing the results of the most recent throughput (speed) test from the BSS to a station (STA).

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: Timestamp for the throughput test, indicating when the test completed.

parameter.name: ClientMAC
parameter.description: MAC address of the STA that the throughput test ran to.

parameter.name: VID
parameter.description:
The VLAN ID (VID) that the throughput test ran on.
A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameter.name: WMMUP
parameter.description:
Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) {{bibref|WMM}} that the throughput test was requested to run on.
A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameter.name: TestDuration
parameter.description: Duration of the throughput test in {{units}}.

parameter.name: TestLayer
parameter.description: The OSI layer that the throughput test ran on.

parameter.name: TestAlgorithm
parameter.description: The test algorithm that the throughput test used.

parameter.name: DownlinkSpeed
parameter.description: Downlink speed found by the throughput test in {{units}}.

parameter.name: UplinkSpeed
parameter.description: Uplink speed found by the throughput test in {{units}}.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.LatencyTestResult.
object.description: Object containing the results of the most recent latency test set from the BSS to a station (STA). Each latency test set includes a number of individual echo tests. Each echo test result provides a sample of round-trip times and statistics on all the echo tests in this latency test are reported in this object.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: Timestamp for the latency test, indicating when the last echo in the latency test set was received or timed-out.

parameter.name: ClientMAC
parameter.description: MAC address of the station (STA) or EasyMesh Agent that the latency test ran to.

parameter.name: VID
parameter.description:
The VLAN ID (VID) that the latency test ran on.
A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameter.name: WMMUP
parameter.description:
Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) {{bibref|WMM}} that the latency test was requested to run on.
A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameter.name: DataBlockSize
parameter.description:
The size of each data block, in {{units}}, that was transmitted in each echo test. The data block excludes the packet or frame header.
A value of 0 indicates that no DataBlockSize was specified.

parameter.name: TestLayer
parameter.description: The OSI layer that the latency test ran on.

parameter.name: TestAlgorithm
parameter.description: The test algorithm that the latency test used.

parameter.name: SuccessCount
parameter.description:
The number of successfully received echo responses.
This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameter.name: LostCount
parameter.description:
The number of lost echoes in the latency test set.
This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameter.name: AverageResponseTime
parameter.description:
The average round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This average is across successfully received echoes only.
This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameter.name: MinimumResponseTime
parameter.description:
The minimum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This minimum is across successfully received echoes only.
This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameter.name: MaximumResponseTime
parameter.description:
The maximum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in {{units}}. This maximum is across successfully received echoes only.
This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameter.description: Indicates whether QoS Map is enabled on this BSS.

parameter.name: MSCSEnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether Mirrored Stream Classification Service (MSCS) is enabled on this BSS.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.
object.description: Object describing a single Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: MACAddress
parameter.description:
The MAC address of an associated device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.MACAddress}}.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: HTCapabilities
parameter.description: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: VHTCapabilities
parameter.description: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: HECapabilities
ClientCapabilities
parameter.description: The frame body of the most recently received (Re)Association Request frame from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of {{bibref|802.11-2020}} in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

parameter.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameter.description:
The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the associated device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataDownlinkRate}}.

parameter.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameter.description:
The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the associated device to the access point.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataUplinkRate}}.

parameter.name: UtilizationReceive
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from this Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to this Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the downlink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the uplink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: SignalStrength
parameter.description:
An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the associated STA to the access point - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.SignalStrength}}.

parameter.name: LastConnectTime
parameter.description: The time in {{units}} since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

parameter.name: BytesSent
parameter.description:
The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesSent}}.

parameter.name: BytesReceived
parameter.description:
The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesReceived}}.

parameter.name: PacketsSent
parameter.description:
The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsSent}}.

parameter.name: PacketsReceived
parameter.description:
The total number of packets received from the Associated Device.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsReceived}}.

parameter.name: ErrorsSent
parameter.description:
The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit, or from other causes.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsSent}}.

parameter.name: ErrorsReceived
parameter.description:
The total number of inbound packets that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsReceived}}.

parameter.name: RetransCount
parameter.description:
The total number of transmitted packets which were retransmissions. Two retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by two.
If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.RetransCount}}.

parameter.name: MeasurementReport
parameter.description: {{list}} Measurement Report element(s) received from the Associated Device (STA) that constitute the latest Beacon report as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-230}}.

parameter.name: NumberOfMeasureReports
parameter.description: The number of measurement report elements contained in {{param|MeasurementReport}}.

parameter.name: IPV4Address
parameter.description: IPV4 Address assigned to the client.

parameter.name: IPV6Address
parameter.description: IPV6Address assigned to the client.

parameter.name: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname assigned to the client.

parameter.name: CellularDataPreference
ReAssociationDelay

parameter.name: SecurityAssociation
parameter.description: This parameter indicates the current operating security state as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 12.6.1.1}}. {{enum}}

parameter.name: PairwiseAKM
parameter.description: Pairwise AKM suite selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.

parameter.name: PairwiseCipher
parameter.description: Pairwise AKM cipher selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM cipher selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149, OUI field}}.

parameter.name: RSNCapabilities
parameter.description: The RSN Capabilities selected by the STA during association {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.24.4,}}.

command.name: ClientSteer()
command.description:
Initiates an EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} Controller initiated steering mandate request to steer a STA from one EasyMesh agent to another.
The steering mechanism is determined by the EasyMesh controller. Application of BTM or non BTM steering, timing, failsafes, and command rejection are determined by the EasyMesh controller.
The {{param|TargetBSSID}} should be an instance of a {{param|#.BSSID}}.

parameter.name: TargetBSSID
parameter.description:
Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID) or AP MLD MAC Address of the target BSS which the associated device(s) is to be steered to.
Wildcard BSSID is represented by FFFFFFFFFFFF.

parameter.name: RequestMode
parameter.description: The request mode. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Request is a Steering Opportunity, indicated by 0 in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 49}}.
Request is a Steering Mandate to trigger steering for specific client STA(s), indicated by 1 in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 49}}.

parameter.name: BTMDisassociationImminent
parameter.description: BTM disassociation imminent.

parameter.name: BTMAbridged
parameter.description: BTM abridged.

parameter.name: LinkRemovalImminent
parameter.description: Link removal imminent.

parameter.name: SteeringOpportunityWindow
BTMDisassociationTimer
parameter.description: Time period in {{units}} of the disassociation timer in the BTM Request.

parameter.name: TargetBSSOperatingClass
parameter.description:
The Target BSS Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}.
If the {{param|TargetBSSID}} is set to "Wildcard BSSID", then this is ignored.

parameter.name: TargetBSSChannel
parameter.description:
Target BSS channel number for channel on which the Target BSS is transmitting Beacon frames.
If the {{param|TargetBSSID}} is set to "Wildcard BSSID", then then this is ignored.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the response to the Wi-Fi backhaul steering request. {{enum}}

parameter.name: Status

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.MultiAPSTA.SteeringHistory.{i}.
object.description:
The history of Multi-AP Steering for this STA on the Wi-Fi network.
The contents of this multi-instance object are reset on reboot.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: The date/time when steering was initiated for the Associated Device.

parameter.name: APOrigin
parameter.description: The BSSID of the Access Point that initiated the steering.

parameter.name: TriggerEvent
parameter.description:
The type of event that caused the steering to be initiaited. {{enum}}
NOTE: This might be Unknown for BTM Query Response steers.

parameter.name: SteeringApproach
parameter.description: The type of steering that was attempted. {{enum}}

parameter.name: APDestination
parameter.description:
The BSSID of the destination Access Point of a successful steer.
A failed steering attempt will leave this parameter {{empty}}.

parameter.name: SteeringDuration
parameter.description:
The amount of time in {{units}} required for the steer to complete successfully.
A failed steering attempt will leave this parameter 0.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.WiFi6Capabilities.
object.description: Describes the Wi-Fi 6 capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: HE160
parameter.description: Indicates support for High Efficiency (HE) 160 MHz.

parameter.name: HE8080
parameter.description: Indicates support for HE 80+80 MHz.

parameter.name: MCSNSS
parameter.description: Supported High Efficiency-Modulation and Coding Scheme (HE-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11ax|Figure 9-788d}} Supported HE-MCS And NSS Set field format. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 160MHz is present if 160MHz is supported. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 80+80MHz is present if 80+80MHz is supported.

parameter.name: SUBeamformer
parameter.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformer.

parameter.name: SUBeamformee
parameter.description: Indicates support for SU Beamformee.

parameter.name: MUBeamformer
parameter.description: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer.

parameter.name: Beamformee80orLess
parameter.description: Indicates support for Beamformee Space-Time Stream (STS) ≤ 80 MHz.

parameter.name: BeamformeeAbove80
parameter.description: Indicates support for Beamformee STS > 80 MHz.

parameter.name: ULMUMIMO
parameter.description: Indicates support for Uplink (UL) Multi-User Multiple Input, Multiple Output (MU-MIMO).

parameter.name: ULOFDMA
parameter.description: Indicates support for UL Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

parameter.name: DLOFDMA
parameter.description: Indicates support for Downlink (DL) Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

parameter.name: MaxDLMUMIMO
parameter.description: Max number of users supported per DL MU-MIMO Transmitter (TX) in the BSS role.

parameter.name: MaxULMUMIMO
parameter.description: Max number of users supported per UL MU-MIMO Receiver (RX) in the BSS role.

parameter.name: MaxDLOFDMA
parameter.description: Max number of users supported per Downlink (DL) OFDMA TX in the BSS role.

parameter.name: MaxULOFDMA
parameter.description: Max number of users supported per UL OFDMA RX in the BSS role.

parameter.name: RTS
parameter.description: Indicates support for Request To Send (RTS).

parameter.name: MURTS
parameter.description: Indicates support for MU RTS.

parameter.name: MultiBSSID
parameter.description: Indicates support for Multi-Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID).

parameter.name: MUEDCA
parameter.description: Indicates support for MU Enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA).

parameter.name: TWTRequestor
parameter.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Requestor.

parameter.name: TWTResponder
parameter.description: Indicates support for TWT Responder.

parameter.name: SpatialReuse
parameter.description: Indicates support for EasyMesh configuration and reporting of BSS Color and Spatial Reuse.

parameter.name: AnticipatedChannelUsage
parameter.description: Indicates support for Anticipated Channel Usage (ACU) reporting.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.HaLowCapabilities.
object.description: Describes the HaLow capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). most of which can be extracted from the Sub 1 GHz (S1G) capabilities Information Element (IE) in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.200.2}}.

parameter.name: BW8MHz

parameter.name: BW16MHz
parameter.description: Indicates support for 16 MHz operation.
