parameter.name: BW1MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 1 MHz short Guard Interval (GI).

parameter.name: BW2MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 2 MHz short GI.

parameter.name: BW4MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 4 MHz short GI.

parameter.name: BW8MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 8 MHz short GI.

parameter.name: BW16MHzShortGI
parameter.description: Indicates support for 16 MHz short GI.

parameter.name: AMSDU
parameter.description: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Service Data Units (AMSDU).

parameter.name: AMPDU
parameter.description: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Protocol Data Units (AMPDU).

parameter.name: FlowControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Flow Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.61}}.

parameter.name: CentralizedAuthenticationControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Centralized Authentication Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.2}}.

parameter.name: DistributedAuthenticationControl
parameter.description: Indicates support for Distributed Authentication Control (DAC) {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.3}}.

parameter.name: MaxMPDULen
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum MAC Protocol Data Unit (MPDU) length in octets. {{enum}}

parameter.name: NonTIMMode
parameter.description: Indicates support of non-Traffic Indication Map (non-TIM) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.48}}.

parameter.name: DynamicAID
parameter.description: Indicates support of Dynamic Association ID (AID) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.20}}.

parameter.name: GroupAID
parameter.description: Indicates support of Group Association ID (AID) {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.55}}.

parameter.name: BATSupport
parameter.description: Indicates support for the use of the Block Acknowledgment TWT (BAT) frame in Block Agreements {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.8.4.3}}.

parameter.name: RAWOperation
parameter.description: Indicates support for Restricted access window (RAW) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.23.5}}.

parameter.name: PageSlicing
parameter.description: Indicates support for Page Slicing Operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.51}}.

parameter.name: PV1Frame
parameter.description: Indicates support for Protocol Version 1 (PV1) frames {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.8}}.

parameter.name: TxMCSNSS
parameter.description: Supported Tx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-694}}.

parameter.name: RxMCSNSS
parameter.description: Supported Rx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-694}}.

parameter.name: SUBeamformer
parameter.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformer {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameter.name: SUBeamformee
parameter.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformee {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameter.name: MUBeamformer
parameter.description: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameter.name: MUBeamformee

parameter.name: TravelingPilot

parameter.name: TWTGrouping

parameter.name: TWTRequestor

parameter.name: TWTResponder
parameter.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) TWTResponder {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.47 Target wake time (TWT)}}.

parameter.name: IsSensorDevice
parameter.description: Indicates if this is a sensor device. A value of {{false}} indicates this is a non-sensor device.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.TIDQueueSizes.{i}.
object.description: Object describing Traffic Identifiers (TIDs), and Queue Size for each TID, for this Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: TID
parameter.description: The TID of the corresponding Queue Size field.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: Queue Size for this TID. Its format is defined in Table 9-10-QoS Control field {{bibref|802.11-2020}}.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.MultiAPRadio.
object.description: This object represents an individual Access Point Radio in the Wi-Fi network.

parameter.name: RadarDetections

command.name: FullScan()

parameter.name: DwellTime
parameter.description: The duration of the time to scan each channel in {{units}}. A value of 50 {{units}} is suggested.

parameter.name: DFSDwellTime
parameter.description: The duration of time to scan each Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) channel in {{units}}. A value of at least one beacon interval, typically 100 {{units}}, is suggested.

parameter.name: HomeTime
parameter.description: The time in {{units}} after which the driver has to go back to the original channel before scanning the next channel to avoid disruption. If this is omitted, or is not supported by the device, then it should be ignored.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The Service Set Identifier (SSID) to scan. If omitted, then all SSIDs are scanned.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the type of outcome of the request to initiate a full band scan. {{enum}}

object.name: ScanResult.{i}.
object.description: The list of neighboring Access Points discovered by a Radio organized per Operating Class and Channel tuple.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The timestamp of the last scan. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: AggregateScanDuration
parameter.description: Total time spent performing the scan of this channel in {{units}}.

parameter.name: ScanType
parameter.description: Indicates whether the scan was performed passively (false) or with active probing (true).

object.name: ScanResult.{i}.OpClassScan.{i}.
object.description: The Operating Class of neighboring Access Points discovered by a Radio during a channel scan.

parameter.name: OperatingClass
parameter.description:
The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}} of the OpClass and Channel tuple scanned by the Radio. For 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, only 20MHz Operating Classes are valid.
Note that the Operating Class identifies the band and channel width.

object.name: ScanResult.{i}.OpClassScan.{i}.ChannelScan.{i}.
object.description: The Channel associated with an Operating Class of neighboring Access Points discovered by a Radio during a channel scan.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The channel number of the Channel scanned by the Radio given the Operating Class.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The timestamp of the last scan of the channel. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: Utilization
parameter.description: The current Channel Utilization measured by the Radio on the scanned 20MHz channel, as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.

parameter.name: Noise
parameter.description:
An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power measured for the primary operating channel.
Encoded as defined for ANPI in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.10.9.4}}.

parameter.name: ScanStatus
parameter.description: Status code to indicate whether a scan has been performed and if not the reason for failure {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Success
Scan not supported on this opclass and channel
Request too soon after last scan
Radio too busy to perform scan
Scan not completed
Scan aborted
Fresh scan not supported, radio only supports on boot scans
reserved

object.name: ScanResult.{i}.OpClassScan.{i}.ChannelScan.{i}.NeighborBSS.{i}.
object.description:
The neighboring BSS discovered by a Radio during a channel scan.
For MLDs, {{param|MLDMACAddress}} identifies the APMLD for which this NeighborBSS.{i}. is an affilated AP, other affiliated APs in this {{object}} have the same value of {{param|MLDMACAddress}}.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: The BSSID indicated by the neighboring BSS.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The SSID indicated by the neighboring BSS.

parameter.name: SignalStrength
parameter.description: An indicator of radio signal strength (RSSI) of the Beacon or Probe Response frames of the neighboring BSS as received by the radio measured in {{units}}. (RSSI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameter.name: ChannelBandwidth
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum bandwidth at which the neighboring BSS is operating. e.g. "1" or "2" or "4" or "8"” or "16" or "20" or "40" or "80" or "80+80" or "160" or "320" MHz.

parameter.name: ChannelUtilization
parameter.description: The channel utilization reported by the neighboring BSS per the BSS Load element if present in Beacon or Probe Response frames, as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.

parameter.name: StationCount
parameter.description: The number of Associated Devices (STA) reported by this neighboring BSS per the BSS Load element if present in Beacon or Probe Response frames as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.

parameter.name: MLDMACAddress
parameter.description: The Multi-Link Device (MLD) MAC address of the Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable access point this neighboring BSS is affiliated to. Null if the neighboring BSS is not an affiliated AP.

parameter.name: ReportingBSSID
parameter.description: The BSSID of the reporting BSSID if different from {{param|BSSID}}. This will be set if the NeigborBSS was discovered through, for example, a Reduced Neighbor Report. EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Channel Scan Result TLV.

parameter.name: MultiBSSID
parameter.description: Indicates if the neighboring BSS is part of a MultiBSSID set and may be a non-transmitted BSSID.

parameter.name: BSSLoadElementPresent
parameter.description: Set to true if the neighbour BSS Beacon/Probe Responses include a BSSLoad Element as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.28}}.

parameter.name: BSSColor
parameter.description: Set to the BSS Color from the BSS Color Information field in the BSS's HE Operation element.

parameter.name: SecurityModeEnabled
parameter.description:
The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises.
The {{enum|WEP}} value indicates either WEP-64 or WEP-128.
The {{enum|WPA}} value is the same as WPA-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA2}} value is the same as WPA2-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA-WPA2}} value is the same as WPA-WPA2-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA3-SAE}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal.
The {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal-Transition.
The {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE-RSNO}} value is the same as WPA3-Personal-Compatibility.

parameter.name: EncryptionMode
parameter.description:
The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises.
When {{param|SecurityModeEnabled}} is one of {{enum|WPA3-SAE|SecurityModeEnabled}}, {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE|SecurityModeEnabled}}, or {{enum|WPA2-PSK-WPA3-SAE-RSNO|SecurityModeEnabled}}, or {{enum|WPA3-Enterprise|SecurityModeEnabled}}, {{enum|TKIP}} is not valid, and should not be in the list.

parameter.name: SupportedStandards
parameter.description:
{{list}} List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standards this {{object}} instance can support simultaneously, in the frequency band specified by {{param|#.Channel}}. {{enum}}
Each value indicates support for the indicated standard.

enumeration.description: {{bibref|802.11ax}}
{{bibref|802.11be}}

parameter.name: OperatingStandards
parameter.description:
{{list}} List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standard that is detected for this {{object}}.
Each value indicates support for the indicated standard.
For example, a value of "g,b" (or "b,g" - order is not important) means that the 802.11g standard {{bibref|802.11g-2003}} is used with a backwards-compatible mode for 802.11b {{bibref|802.11b-1999}}. A value of "g" means that only the 802.11g standard can be used.

parameter.name: BasicDataTransferRates
parameter.description: {{list}} Basic data transmit rates (in Mbps) for the SSID. For example, if {{param}} is "1,2", this indicates that the SSID is operating with basic rates of 1 Mbps and 2 Mbps.

parameter.name: SupportedDataTransferRates
parameter.description: {{list}} Data transmit rates (in Mbps) for unicast frames at which the SSID will permit a station to connect. For example, if {{param}} is "1,2,5.5", this indicates that the SSID will only permit connections at 1 Mbps, 2 Mbps and 5.5 Mbps.

parameter.name: SupportedNSS
parameter.description: The maximum number of spatial streams (NSS) that can be supported.

parameter.name: DTIMPeriod
parameter.description: The number of beacon intervals (measured in {{units}}) that elapse between transmission of Beacon frames containing a TIM element whose DTIM count field is 0. This value is transmitted in the DTIM Period field of beacon frames. {{bibref|802.11-2020}}

parameter.name: BeaconPeriod
parameter.description: Time interval (in {{units}}) between transmitting beacons.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.APMLD.{i}.APMLDConfig.TIDToOpClassPolicy.{i}.
object.description: Table of Traffic Identifier (TID) to Operating Class to be used as a policy when configuring TID-to-Link Mapping in the Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable access point (AP). Each table entry describes the mapping between a particular TID and direction and the required current Operating Class for any link to be used for this TID when constructing a TID-to-Link Map {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 20.2.8}}.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: This parameter indicates whether the TID-to-Link mapping entry is enabled for Multi-Link Operation (MLO) on the access point (AP). When set to "true", the mapping between the specified Traffic Identifier (TID), direction, and required Operating Class will be active, and the TID-to-Link mapping policy will be applied during Multi-Link operations. When set to "false", the entry will be ignored.

parameter.name: TID
parameter.description: The traffic identifier (TID) for this mapping. This {{param}} is a unique key for this table.

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description: {{list}} The Operating class of an available channel, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. The TID can be mapped to any link using a radio with a current operating class within this list.

parameter.name: Direction
parameter.description: The direction of the traffic flow from the perspective the APMLD. {{enum}} This {{param}} is a unique key for this table.

parameter.name: LinkID
parameter.description: {{list}} The Link ID of the preferred link (affiliated AP) to use for traffic with matching direction and TID values.

parameter.description: The Radio unique identifier (RUID) of the Radio that this affiliated AP is operating on. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV.

parameter.description: Disabled Subchannel Bitmap subfield from the EHT Operation element in transmitted Management frames. Null value or not present for stations. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Static Puncturing Configuration TLV.

parameter.description: The number of packets transmitted by the Affiliated AP. Note: this counter counts only MLD traffic through this BSSID, not legacy (non-MLD) traffic. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: PacketsReceived
parameter.description: The total number of packets received from the affiliated STAs by this Affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: UnicastBytesSent
parameter.description: Total number of unicast bytes transmitted to MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: UnicastBytesReceived
parameter.description: Total number of unicast bytes received from MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: ErrorsSent
parameter.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted by the Affiliated AP due to errors. This counter counts only MLD traffic through this BSSID, not legacy (non-MLD) traffic. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: MulticastBytesSent
parameter.description: Total multicast bytes transmitted to MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: MulticastBytesReceived
parameter.description: Total multicast bytes received from MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: BroadcastBytesSent
parameter.description: Total broadcast bytes transmitted to MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: BroadcastBytesReceived
parameter.description: Total broadcast bytes received from MLD STAs associated with the affiliated AP. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated AP Metrics TLV.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersBE
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BE, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersBK
parameter.description: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BK, defined per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-637}} and referenced in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.22}}.

parameter.name: EstServiceParametersVI

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.APMLD.{i}.STAMLD.{i}.
object.description: This object describes Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable stations (STAs), also known as client Multilink Devices (MLDs), associated to this MLO capable Access Point. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated Clients TLV.

parameter.name: MLDMACAddress
parameter.description: The Multi-Link Device (MLD) MAC Address of the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA MLD Configuration Report TLV.

parameter.name: Hostname
parameter.description: The Hostname for the client MLD STA.

parameter.name: IPv4Address
parameter.description: The IPv4 address allocated to the MLD MAC Address of this device.

parameter.name: IPv6Address
parameter.description: The IPv6 address allocated to the MLD MAC Address of this device.

parameter.name: IsbSTA
parameter.description: Indicates if the client MLD STA is a backhaul MLD STA (bSTAMLD). This is useful when the same AP MLD has both client MLD and bSTAMLDs associated. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Backhaul STA MLD Configuration TLV.

parameter.name: LastConnectTime
parameter.description: The time in {{units}} since this client MLD STA was associated.

parameter.name: BytesSent
parameter.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: BytesReceived
parameter.description: The total number of bytes received from the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: PacketsSent
parameter.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: PacketsReceived
parameter.description: The total number of packets received from the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: ErrorsSent
parameter.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the client MLD STA due to errors. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: ErrorsReceived
parameter.description: The number of packets which were received with error from the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: RetransCount
parameter.description: The number of packets transmitted with the retry flag sent to the client MLD STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.name: PairwiseAKM
parameter.description: Pairwise AKM suite selector selected by the STAMLD. The Pairwise AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.

parameter.name: PairwiseCipher
parameter.description: Pairwise AKM cipher selector selected by the STAMLD. The Pairwise AKM cipher selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149}}.

parameter.name: RSNCapabilities
parameter.description: The RSN Capabilities selected by the STAMLD during association {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.24.4}}.

parameter.name: MACAddress
parameter.description: The MAC address of the affiliated STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA MLD Configuration Report TLV.

parameter.description: The BSSID of the affiliated AP that the affiliated STA is associated to. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA MLD Configuration Report TLV.

parameter.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the affiliated STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.description: The total number of bytes received from the affiliated STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the affiliated STA. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the affiliated STA due to errors. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Associated STA Traffic Stats TLV.

parameter.description: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the affiliated STA to the access point - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the downlink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the uplink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameter.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the affiliated STA.

parameter.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameter.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the affiliated STA to the access point.

parameter.name: UtilizationReceive
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the APMLD Radio has spent on the channel receiving data from the affiliated STA.

parameter.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the APMLD Radio has spent on the channel transmitting data to the affiliated STA.

parameter.description: {{list}} backhaul STA MAC addresses affiliated to this bSTAMLD. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Backhaul STA MLD Configuration TLV.

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.AssociationEvent.
object.description: This object contains the events generated when a STA associates to a BSS.

parameter.name: AssociationEventDataNumberOfEntries

event.name: Associated!
event.description: The event is generated when an Associated Device (STA) associates to a BSS.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Association Event.

parameter.name: MACAddress
parameter.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the Client MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: StatusCode
parameter.description: The status code sent to the Associated Device (STA) in the Association Response frame as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-50}}.

parameter.name: HTCapabilities
parameter.description: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: VHTCapabilities
parameter.description: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: HECapabilities
ClientCapabilities
parameter.description: The frame body of the (Re)Association Request frame received from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of {{bibref|802.11-2020}} in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

parameter.name: MaxULOFDMA
parameter.description: Max number of users supported per UL OFDMA RX in the BSS role.

parameter.description: Indicates support for Multi-Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID).

parameter.name: AnticipatedChannelUsage

object.name: Device.WiFi.DataElements.DisassociationEvent.
object.description: This object contains the events generated when an Associated Device (STA) disassociates from a BSS.

parameter.name: DisassociationEventDataNumberOfEntries

event.name: Disassociated!
event.description: The event is generated when an Associated Device (STA) disassociates from a BSS.

parameter.name: BSSID
parameter.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Disassociation Event.

parameter.name: MACAddress
parameter.description: If a MLD, the MAC Address of the Client MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: ReasonCode
parameter.description: The Reason Code received by the AP from the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame or sent by the AP to the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-49}}.

parameter.name: BytesSent
parameter.description:
The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device (STA).
For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by {{param|Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits}}.

parameter.name: BytesReceived
parameter.description:
The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device (STA).
For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by {{param|Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits}}.

parameter.name: PacketsSent
parameter.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: PacketsReceived
parameter.description: The total number of packets received from the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: ErrorsSent
parameter.description: The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted to the Associated Device (STA) because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit or from other causes.

parameter.name: ErrorsReceived
parameter.description: The total number of inbound packets from the Associated Device (STA) that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.

parameter.name: RetransCount
parameter.description:
The total number of transmitted packets to the Associated Device (STA) which were retransmissions.
N retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by N.

parameter.name: TimeStamp
parameter.description: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameter.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameter.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameter.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point.

parameter.name: UtilizationReceive
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameter.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to the Associated Device (STA).

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the downlink direction to the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameter.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the uplink direction from the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameter.name: SignalStrength
parameter.description: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameter.name: LastConnectTime
parameter.description: The time in {{units}} since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

parameter.name: Noise
parameter.description:
An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power at the access point measured for the primary operating channel to this Associated Device (STA).
Encoded as defined for ANPI in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.10.9.4}}.

parameter.name: InitiatedBy
parameter.description: This parameter indicates the entity that initiated this Disassociation Event. {{enum}}

parameter.name: OpClass
parameter.description: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV}} and the Supported Operating Classes element in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV}}. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

parameter.name: PacketsReceived

parameter.name: ErrorsSent
parameter.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the affiliated STA because of errors.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.
object.description:
Wi-Fi Configuration Templates provide a comprehensive way to configure Wi-Fi. Configuration Templates can be applied across multiple deployments in an operator's network, and across multiple APs, radios and BSSs. A set of Configuration Templates can be pre-defined, which can then handle many different services and scenarios by matching flags to select a particular template depending on AP or radio capabilities and topology. Different BSSs can be configured across different radios to provision different types of services.
A detailed description of how to use Wi-Fi Configuration Templates is in {{bibref|DataElements|Section 3.4}}. The Configuration Template Manager (CTM) interprets and implements Configuration Templates for each deployment.

parameter.name: BSSTemplateNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: RadioTemplateNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: SecurityTemplateNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: SecurityGroupNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: APMLDTemplateNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: SSCTemplateNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.Network.
object.description: This {{object}} either has the Configuration Template Manager (CTM) deploy BSS(s) according to the templates, or has all BSS(s) be disabled.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
Indicates whether any BSS may be deployed in the Wi-Fi network.
: {{true}}: BSS(s) are deployed according to the template matching process.
: {{false}}: No BSS is deployed in the network.

parameter.name: TopologyFlag
parameter.description:
The TopologyFlag is used to specify a list of EasyMesh Agents on which BSS(es) are deployed according to the template matching process. If an EasyMesh Agent does not match any value in the list, then no BSS is deployed on this EasyMesh Agent.
These values refer to the network topology role of the EasyMesh Agent as determined by the EasyMesh Controller.
This flag matches if any of the list items match (logical OR).
{{list}}{{enum}}

enumeration.description: Colocated with the EasyMesh Controller.
Not colocated with the EasyMesh Controller.
Uses wired backhaul, i.e. all links between this EasyMesh Agent and the EasyMesh Controller are wired.
Uses wireless backhaul, i.e. at least one link between this EasyMesh Agent and the EasyMesh Controller is wireless.
Indicates an IEEE 1905 ALID, the value of which is a list item in {{param|IEEE1905ALID}}.

parameter.name: IEEE1905ALID
parameter.description:
{{list}} IEEE 1905 {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a}} Abstraction-Layer ID (ALID).
This matches if any of the list items match (logical OR). This should match an entry in {{param|##.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.ID}}.

parameter.name: PrimarySSCTemplateReference
parameter.description:
Incicates the Primary SSCTemplate.
The PrimaryVLANID in the EasyMesh network is the VLANID of the SSCTemplate referenced by {{param}}. If this value is empty, then Traffic Separation is not used. {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 19}}.

parameter.name: PrimarySSCTemplateID
parameter.description:
Indicates the Primary SSCTemplate.
The value must be the {{param|#.SSCTemplate.{i}.SSCTemplateID}} to identify an instance of {{object|#.SSCTemplate}}. If this value is empty, then Traffic Separation is not used. {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 19}}.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.BSSTemplate.{i}.
object.description: Table of Basic Service Set (BSS) templates for Wi-Fi configuration.

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: BSSTemplateID
parameter.description: Static and persistent ID element. At most one {{object}} instance can exist with a given value for {{param}}.

parameter.name: Priority
parameter.description: This value indicates in which order the {{object}} are to be matched for a reported radio. 255 is the highest priority, 0 is the lowest priority.

parameter.name: RadioTemplateReference
parameter.description: This {{object}} is linked to {{param}}.

parameter.name: SSCTemplateReference
parameter.description: This {{object}} is linked to {{param}}.

parameter.name: APMLDTemplateReference
parameter.description: This {{object}} is linked to {{param}}.

parameter.name: SecurityGroupReference
parameter.description: This {{object}} is linked to {{param}}.

parameter.name: LinkedRadioTemplateID
parameter.description: Indicates the {{param|#.RadioTemplate.{i}.RadioTemplateID}} that is linked with this {{object}}.

parameter.name: LinkedSSCTemplateID
parameter.description: Indicates the {{param|#.SSCTemplate.{i}.SSCTemplateID}} that is linked with this {{object}}.

parameter.name: LinkedAPMLDTemplateID
parameter.description: Indicates the {{param|#.APMLDTemplate.{i}.APMLDTemplateID}} that is linked with this {{object}}.

parameter.name: LinkedSecurityGroupID
parameter.description: Indicates the {{param|#.SecurityGroup.{i}.SecurityGroupID}} of the {{object|#.SecurityGroup.{i}}} in which a matching {{object|#.SecurityTemplate}} is searched.

parameter.name: TopologyFlag

enumeration.description: Colocated with the EasyMesh Controller.
Not colocated with the EasyMesh Controller.
Uses wired backhaul, i.e. all links between this EasyMesh Agent and the EasyMesh Controller are wired.
Uses wireless backhaul, i.e. at least one link between this EasyMesh Agent and the EasyMesh Controller is wireless.
Indicates an IEEE 1905 ALID, the value of which is a list item in {{param|IEEE1905ALID}}.

parameter.name: IEEE1905ALID
parameter.description:
{{list}} IEEE 1905 {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a}} Abstraction-Layer ID (ALID).
This flag matches if any of the list items match (logical OR). This should match an entry in {{param|##.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.ID}}.

parameter.name: MaxWLANHopLimitFlag
parameter.description:
Indicates the maximum number of wireless hops (consecutive or not) allowed between the EasyMesh Controller and the EasyMesh Agent.
In single-AP deployment, this flag is ignored.

parameter.name: SecureEquipmentFlag
parameter.description: Indicates the 1905 Security of the EasyMesh Agent {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.77}}. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Indicates that 1905 Security is supported and being used by the EasyMesh Agent.
Indicates that 1905 Security is not being used by the EasyMesh Agent.
No requirement for matching.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Determines if this template is considered by the Configuration Template Manager in the template matching process.

parameter.name: SSID
parameter.description: The Service Set Identifier (SSID) used as an identifier by all deployed BSSs linked to this {{object}}.

parameter.name: KeyPassphrase
parameter.description: The KeyPassphrase to be used by all deployed BSSs linked to this {{object}}.

parameter.name: AdvertisementEnable
parameter.description:
Indicates if the {{param|SSID}} is advertised in beacons
: {{true}}: this {{param|SSID}} is to be advertised in beacons.
: {{false}}: this {{param|SSID}} is not to be advertised in beacons.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.RadioTemplate.{i}.
object.description: Table of RadioTemplates for Wi-Fi configuration.

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: RadioTemplateID
parameter.description:
Static and persistent ID element. At most one {{object}} instance can exist with a given value for {{param}}.
Note that {{param}} is not the same as {{param|##.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.ID}}.

parameter.name: Priority
parameter.description: This value indicates in which order the {{object}} are to be matched for a radio under configuration. 255 is the highest priority, 0 is the lowest priority.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
Determines if this {{object}} is considered by the Configuration Template Manager (CTM) in the template matching process.
This value is independent from the value of any {{param|##.Radio.{i}.Enable}}. This value is also independent from the value of any {{param|##.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.Enabled}}.

parameter.name: OpClassFlag
parameter.description:
{{list}} Each list item is a global valid operating class as defined in {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}).
Indicates the Operating Classes the Radio can operate on. Exactly one of {{param}} or {{param|BandFlag}} must be empty and exactly one must be filled in.
A Radio must be able to operate on at least one channel of each Operating Class specified in this list to satisfy this condition.

parameter.name: BandFlag

enumeration.description: 2.4 GHz band
The entire 5 GHz band
The entire 6 GHz band
5 GHz UNII-1 band, 5.15 to 5.25 GHz
5 GHz UNII-2 band, 5.25 to 5.725 GHz
5 GHz UNII-3 band, 5.725 to 5.85 GHz
5 GHz UNII-4 band, 5.85 to 5.925 GHz
6 GHz UNII-5 band, 5.925 to 6.425 GHz
6 GHz UNII-6 band, 6.425 to 6.525 GHz
6 GHz UNII-7 band, 6.525 to 6.875 GHz
6 GHz UNII-8 band, 6.875 to 7.125 GHz
Sub 1 GHz band, 800 MHz to 928 MHz

parameter.name: SupportedGenerationFlag
parameter.description:
{{list}} Each list item indicates a supported Wi-Fi Generation. Each list item indicates a Supported Generation of Generational Capabilities Indication attribute.
For example {{param}} could be "5,6,7".

parameter.name: DFSSupportFlag
parameter.description: Indicates Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) support. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Device supports DFS.
Device does not support DFS.
No requirement for matching.

parameter.name: AFCSupportFlag
parameter.description: Indicates Automated Frequency Coordination (AFC) support. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: Device supports AFC.
Device does not support AFC.
No requirement for matching.

parameter.name: TransmitPowerLimit
parameter.description: This is the upper limit on nominal transmit Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) that this radio is allowed to use for the current operating class. In units of decibels relative to 1 mW {{units}}.

parameter.name: OperatingGeneration
parameter.description:
{{list}} Each list item indicates a Wi-Fi Generation deployed on this EasyMesh Agent or this device. The last list item may be followed by a "+" to indicate the inclusion of any existing Wi-Fi Generation above it. If an EasyMesh agent or device supports a Wi-Fi Generation not in the list, then that Wi-Fi Generation is disabled on the EasyMesh agent or device.
For example, "6,7+" means Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 7 and any newer Wi-Fi Generation.
Note: {{param}} may include Wi-Fi Generations not supported by a radio to which this {{object}} is deployed.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.SecurityTemplate.{i}.
object.description: Table of SecurityTemplates for Wi-Fi configuration {{bibref|WPA3v3.0}}.

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: SecurityTemplateID
parameter.description: Static and persistent ID element. At most one {{object}} instance can exist with a given value for {{param}}.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Determines if this template is considered by the Configuration Template Manager in the template matching process.

parameter.name: Priority
parameter.description: This value indicates in which order the {{object}} are to be matched. 255 is the highest priority, 0 is the lowest priority.

parameter.name: RSNOSupportFlag

enumeration.description: The AP shall indicate support for RSNO for this flag to match.
The AP shall not indicate support for RSNO for this flag to match.
This flag matches in all cases.

parameter.name: SupportedAKMSuiteFlag
parameter.description: {{list}} Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suite selector. Only the listed enumeration values are allowed in this string. {{enum}}

enumeration.description: indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:2
indicates AKM 50-6F-9A:2
indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:8
indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:24
indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in {{param|SupportedAKMSuiteSelectorFlag}}.

parameter.name: SupportedAKMSuiteSelectorFlag
parameter.description:
{{list}} AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.
{{param}} applies if {{param|SupportedAKMSuiteFlag}} includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameter.name: OperatingGenerationFlag
parameter.description:
{{list}} The AP advertises support in its beacon frames for each Wi-Fi generation in this list for this flag to match.
For example {{param}} could be "5,6,7".

parameter.name: SecurityIEs
parameter.description:
Concatenation of all BSS Security related IEs with Element IDs, without delimiters as hex encoded octets {{bibref|EasyMesh}}.
Note that this {{param}} and the {{object|RSNE}}, {{object|RSNOE}}, {{object|RSNO2E}}, {{object|RSNXE}}, {{object|RSNXOE}} objects are independent and may be set separately. If this {{param}} is not empty, the Configuration Template Manager (CTM) uses the value of this {{param}} and ignores the content of the RSNE/RSNOE/RSNO2E/RSNXE/RSNXOE objects.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Templates.SecurityTemplate.{i}.RSNE.
object.description: This object describes the Robust Security Network Element (RSNE). This object is only used by the Configuration Template Manager if the {{param|#.SecurityIEs}} is empty.

parameter.name: GroupDataCipherSuite
parameter.description:
Cipher suite selector used to protect group addressed data frames. This is the name of a cipher suite, as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149}}.
The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameter.name: PairwiseCipherSuite
parameter.description:
{{list}} Each list item is a cipher suite selector used to protect individually addressed Data frames, as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149}}.
The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameter.name: AKMSuite
parameter.description: Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suite {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}. {{list}}{{enum}}

enumeration.description: indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:2
indicates AKM 50-6F-9A:2
indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:8
indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:24
indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in {{param|AKMSuiteSelector}}.

parameter.description:

parameter.name: Alias
parameter.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameter.name: APMLDTemplateID
parameter.description: Static and persistent ID element. At most one {{object}} instance can exist with a given value for {{param}}.

parameter.name: MLOEnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether or not Multi-Link Operation (MLO) is enabled. If set to {{false}}, then MLO support is disabled and each deployment of a BSSTemplate related to this {{object}} results in an AP MLD with a single affiliated AP. However, this does not disable the BSSs that are in the {{object|#.BSSTemplate.{i}}} linked to this {{object}}.

parameter.name: STREnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether or not Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (STR) mode is to be enabled on the AP MLD.

parameter.name: NSTREnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether or not Non-Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (NSTR) mode is to be enabled on the AP MLD.

parameter.name: EMLSREnable

parameter.name: EMLMREnable
parameter.description: Indicates whether or not Enhanced Multi-Link Multi-Radio (EMLMR) mode is to be enabled on the AP MLD.

parameter.name: TIDToLinkMapNegotiation
parameter.description: Indicates whether the TID-to-link Mapping Negotiation Support subfield in the MLD Capabilities and Operations field of the Basic Multi-Link element is (to be) enabled by any deployed AP MLD linked to this {{object}}.
